verdict.rationale: First-party docs show an explicit token-streaming API (`generateStream` emitting `.token` events consumed via `for await`) and a dedicated stream docs page describing its use for low-latency, in-progress generation; TTS/STT also expose analogous streaming primitives. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of LLM token streaming specifically (community evidence covers voice-pipeline bugs, not token streaming) and no documented streaming behavior for the OpenAI-compatible cloud endpoint.
